_README: This file is managed by LazyCue (see shelley/lazycue). Do NOT edit by hand — it is the cached, machine-generated DSL for a self-healing browser test. To change behavior, edit the test description and re-run LazyCue.
description:
Microphone capture is discarded and the screen recording submitted for transcription. The page fakes the microphone, screen capture and MediaRecorder, and window.__recordingMock counts what the page asked for (read it with eval, e.g. "window.__recordingMock.recorderStarts"): displayRequests (screen captures requested), synchronousDisplayRequests (those requested inside a click or keydown handler), microphoneRequests, audioSources, recorderStarts, recorderStops and stoppedTracks (media tracks stopped). "The recording state" is the data-state attribute of ".recording-status". Recording uploads (POST /api/upload/raw) answer with the path /tmp/shelley-uploads/screen.webm.json for filenames ending in ".json" and /tmp/shelley-uploads/screen.webm otherwise; call "uploadNames" lists their filenames as JSON, with every digit replaced by "#". Message submissions are accepted without being sent on; call "transcription" returns the last one's message and model as JSON ("none" before there is one). The message input is [data-testid="message-input"], the voice button [data-testid="voice-button"], the recording panel [data-testid="recording-panel"], and its stop, cancel and retry buttons [data-testid="recording-stop-button"], [data-testid="recording-cancel-button"] and [data-testid="recording-retry-button"]. When a step says an element should contain or have some text, assert that on that element, not with a page-wide wait_text. Perform the steps in order. 
1. Navigate to /new and click the voice button. [data-testid="recording-status"] should have the text exactly "Recording…".
2. Click [data-testid="recording-screen-button"].
3. The recording panel should get data-mode "screen", [data-testid="recording-preview"] should be visible, and [data-testid="recording-status"] should have the text exactly "Recording screen + microphone…".
4. Call "uploadNames" must return exactly [].
5. Eval "(m => ({display: m.displayRequests, microphone: m.microphoneRequests, sources: m.audioSources}))(window.__recordingMock)" must return exactly {"display":1,"microphone":2,"sources":4}.
6. Press the stop button with a touch pointerdown: eval "document.querySelector('[data-testid=\"recording-stop-button\"]').dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerdown', {pointerType: 'touch', button: 0, bubbles: true, cancelable: true, composed: true}))".
7. Call "transcription" should return exactly {"message":"/transcription /tmp/shelley-uploads/screen.webm","model":"predictable"}.
8. The message input should have the value "" (empty).
9. Call "uploadNames" must return exactly ["rec-########-######.webm","screen.webm.json"].
